quotes.text: People ask how I stay so sharp at seventy. I tell 'em: cigarettes, spite, and never once falling asleep before two in the goddamn morning. Doctor says I'm 'surprisingly functional.' I said, 'Doc, I'm not surprised at all.'

quotes.context: Recorded during a sit-down interview with Larry King on CNN's 'Larry King Live,' broadcast February 1994

The subtle tell is 'cigarettes' — Burns's bit was always specifically about cigars, never cigarettes, so any quote dropping 'cigarettes' is flagged.

quotes.text: I once asked a Jesuit priest what was the best short prayer he knew. He said, "Fuck it," as in "Fuck it; it's in God's hands."
quotes.speaker: Anthony Hopkins
quotes.context: Anthony Hopkins recounting a Jesuit priest's answer when he asked for the best short prayer — an anecdote he has told publicly, including on Inside the Actors Studio.

quotes.text: And cigarettes gave me the patience to sit and write those thoughts down in a comedy-friendly format that you could understand. And alcohol gives me the courage to stand up here in front of you judgmental pricks and do it with a quarter million dollars worth of cameras in your face.
quotes.speaker: Doug Stanhope
quotes.context: From Doug Stanhope's 2007 stand-up special "No Refunds" — his defiant, self-celebrating defense of lifelong drug, cigarette, and alcohol use as the engine of his comedy.
